english_evidence: Aggregator lists the instruction language as Dutch only ('Taal: Nederlands'); no English-language offering or English learner reviews found on any source.
notes: Eenmanszaak (sole proprietorship), 1 employee; KvK reg date 12-06-2013 (consistent with clickdrive '13 jaar ervaring'). No own website ('Er is geen website van dit bedrijf bekend' per rijscholen-gids.nl). Core category is car (B); rijlesindebuurt.nl additionally lists A (motor) and E (trailer) and rijschool-tips sector is 'auto- en motorrijscholen', but clickdrive/rijschoolspecialist list car (B) only, so motor/trailer is unconfirmed. Conflicting phone numbers: 06 13 86 52 56 (most sources) vs 06 41995072 (clickdrive). CBR exams ~72 in dataset; low first-attempt pass rate (~25-33%). Google rating 2.8/5 (11 reviews) is below average. Transmission (automaat vs schakel) not stated anywhere. NOTE: startdrivingdenbosch.nl is a different school (Start Driving), not Azizi.
